The '''Tostonians''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[Limb|bipedal]] [[species]]. Members of the species had large, round, [[Color|black]] [[eye]]s and mottled pink skin. They possessed two [[Limb|arms]] ending in three-fingered [[hand]]s with sharp claws.<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" /> In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{KenobiDate|II}}</ref> a [[Gender|male]]<ref name="AD">{{Kenobi|Part II}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> Tostonian who spoke an [[alien]] [[language]] worked on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]], at the [[spice]] [[laboratory]] known as [[the Den]]. The [[human]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] followed the Tostonian<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" /> and acquired his [[clothing]],<ref name="AD">{{Kenobi|Part II}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> which the [[Jedi]] then used to infiltrate the Den.<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Tostonian appeared in "[[Part II]]" of the limited television series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']],<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" /> which was released on [[May 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}}</ref> The species was named in the episode's subtitles.<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" />
